title: Transport contract: chunked-and-resumable, multipart POST default, tus.io elicited alternative
description: The upload transport is chunked-and-resumable: an interrupted upload resumes from the last acknowledged offset on retry, and the client retries on transient failures without re-sending acknowledged bytes. The recommended default is a multipart POST with the file split into fixed-size chunks the server assembles server-side. The tus.io resumable upload protocol 1.0.0 is the elicited alternative for projects with a tus server or the third-party SDK; when applied it exposes an Upload-Offset header per PATCH request and supports server-side pause and resume. A per-vendor SDK (S3 multipart, Cloudflare R2 client-direct) is the second elicited alternative when the project has committed to a vendor library.
rationale: Per visual round 4 spec section 5.2, REQ 4.
